questions.stem: What is the name of the series that is experimentally determined based on the absorption of light by complexes with different ligands?
questions.solution: The spectrochemical series is determined by how different ligands affect the absorption of light in complexes, which influences their color. The electrochemical series relates to electron transfer potentials, the reactivity series to how readily metals undergo reactions, and the redox series to oxidation and reduction processes. Only the spectrochemical series is directly connected to light absorption in this context.

questions.stem: Which theory explains the formation, magnetic behaviour and geometrical shapes of coordination compounds?
questions.solution: Valence Bond Theory explains the formation, magnetic behavior, and geometrical shapes of coordination compounds by considering the hybridization of the central metal atom and the formation of bonds with ligands. Crystal Field Theory focuses more on the splitting of d-orbitals in the presence of ligands but does not fully explain the geometrical shapes. Werner's Theory deals with the bonding and structure of coordination compounds but does not address magnetic behavior in detail. Ligand Field Theory is a more advanced concept that builds on Crystal Field Theory and is not as directly related to the basic formation and geometry of the compounds.

hi.stem: कौन सा सिद्धांत समन्वय यौगिकों के बनावट, चुंबकीय व्यवहार और भौतिक आकृति की व्याख्या करता है?

mr.stem: कोऑर्डिनेशन यौगिकांच्या निर्माण, चुंबकीय वर्तन आणि भौमितिक आकारांचे व्याख्यान कोणत्या सिद्धांताने समजले जाते?
mr.solution: संयोजकता बंध सिद्धांत केंद्रीय धातू अणूच्या हायब्रिडीकरणाच्या विचाराने कोऑर्डिनेशन यौगिकांच्या निर्माण, चुंबकीय वर्तन आणि भौमितिक आकारांचे व्याख्यान करते आणि लिगंडशी बंध तयार करते. क्रिस्टल फील्ड सिद्धांत लिगंडच्या उपस्थितीत d-ओर्बिटलच्या विभाजनावर भर देतो परंतु भौमितिक आकारांचे पूर्ण व्याख्यान करत नाही. वर्नरचा सिद्धांत कोऑर्डिनेशन यौगिकांच्या बंधन आणि संरचनेवर विचार करतो परंतु चुंबकीय वर्तनाचे विस्तृत व्याख्यान करत नाही. लिगंड फील्ड सिद्धांत हा क्रिस्टल फील्ड सिद्धांतावर आधारित असलेला अधिक उन्नत अभ्यास आहे आणि यौगिकांच्या मूलभूत निर्माण आणि आकारांशी सीधा संबंध नाही.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a counter ion in the coordination compound [Co(NH3)5(NO2)]Cl2?
questions.solution: Chloride ions are the counter ions in the coordination compound [Co(NH3)5(NO2)]Cl2 because they are outside the coordination sphere and are ionisable. Ammonia and nitro are ligands, and cobalt is the central metal ion.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct rule for naming coordination compounds?
choices: The name of the metal in an anion ends with -ate
The oxidation state of the metal is written in Roman numerals
The ligands are named in the order they appear in the formula
questions.solution: The correct rule is that the oxidation state of the metal is written in Roman numerals. Anionic ligands do end in -o, but this is not the only correct rule. The name of the metal in an anion ends with -ate, but this is also not the only correct rule. The order of ligands is alphabetical, not as they appear in the formula.

questions.stem: Which of the following compounds is an example of a complex ion?
questions.solution: [Fe(CN)6]^4- is a complex ion because it consists of a central metal ion (Fe) coordinated to multiple ligands (CN). KCl, NaCl, and MgSO4 are simple ionic compounds.

hi.solution: [Fe(CN)6]^4- एक सम्पूर्ण आयन है क्योंकि इसमें केंद्रीय धातु आयन (Fe) बहुत सारे लिगैंड (CN) के साथ जुड़ा होता है। KCl, NaCl और MgSO4 साधारण आयनिक यौगिक हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a coordination entity with a coordination number of 6?
questions.solution: The coordination number is the number of ligands directly bonded to the central metal ion. [Co(NH3)6]3+ has six ammonia molecules bonded to the cobalt ion, giving it a coordination number of 6. NiCl2 only has two chloride ions bonded, FeSO4·7H2O has a coordination number of 6 but is not a coordination entity, and CuSO4 does not form a stable coordination complex.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा समन्वयन एकाकी के समन्वयन संख्या 6 का उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: समन्वयन संख्या केंद्रीय धातु आयन पर सीधे बंधे लिगेंड्स की संख्या होती है। [Co(NH3)6]3+ में छह अमोनिया अणु कोबाल्ट आयन पर बंधे होते हैं, जिसके कारण इसकी समन्वयन संख्या 6 होती है। NiCl2 में केवल दो क्लोराइड आयन बंधे होते हैं, FeSO4·7H2O की समन्वयन संख्या 6 होती है लेकिन यह एक समन्वयन एकाकी नहीं है, और CuSO4 एक स्थायी समन्वयन जटिल नहीं बनाता है।

NiCl2 मध्ये केवळ दोन क्लोराइड आयन जोडलेले असतात, FeSO4·7H2O चा संयोजन क्रमांक 6 असतो पण हे संयोजन एकक नसते आणि CuSO4 स्थिर संयोजन जटिल तयार करत नाही.

questions.stem: Which of the following compounds would be expected to be diamagnetic?
questions.solution: The compound [Co(NH3)6]3+ is expected to be diamagnetic because NH3 is a strong field ligand that causes the 3d electrons of Co to pair up, resulting in no unpaired electrons. The other options involve weak field ligands or have unpaired electrons.

questions.stem: A coordination compound has a spin-only magnetic moment of 5.9 BM. What is the geometry of the complex ion if the coordination number of the metal ion is 4?
questions.solution: The geometry of the complex ion is tetrahedral. A magnetic moment of 5.9 BM corresponds to five unpaired electrons, which is typical for a tetrahedral complex with sp³ hybridization. Square planar complexes usually have fewer unpaired electrons due to strong crystal field splitting, and octahedral geometry involves a coordination number of 6, not 4. Pyramidal geometry is not a standard configuration for four-coordinate complexes.

mr.stem: का [Ni(CN)4]2- ची चौकोनी समतलीय ज्यामिती असते, तर [NiCl4]2- ची चौपृष्ठीय ज्यामिती असते?
choices: कारण CN- एक कमकुवत क्षेत्र लिगॅंड आहे
कारण Cl- एक शक्तिशाली क्षेत्र लिगॅंड आहे
कारण CN- एक शक्तिशाली क्षेत्र लिगॅंड आहे
कारण Ni चा ऑक्सिडेशन अवस्था दोन्ही संकरात वेगळी असते
mr.solution: CN- एक शक्तिशाली क्षेत्र लिगॅंड आहे जो Ni च्या d-इलेक्ट्रॉन्सला जोडून ठेवतो, ज्यामुळे dsp² हायब्रिडाईजेशन होते आणि चौकोनी समतलीय ज्यामिती बनते. Cl- हा कमकुवत क्षेत्र लिगॅंड आहे, त्यामुळे तो d-इलेक्ट्रॉन्सला जोडून ठेवत नाही, ज्यामुळे sp³ हायब्रिडाईजेशन होते आणि चौपृष्ठीय ज्यामिती बनते.

questions.stem: Why are chelate complexes more stable than complexes with unidentate ligands?
choices: Because they have more pi bonds
Because they have more sigma bonds
Because they form a ring structure with the metal ion
Because they have more ionic bonds
questions.solution: Chelate complexes are more stable because they form a ring structure with the metal ion, which enhances their stability through increased entropy and stronger bonding interactions. The other options are incorrect because pi bonds, sigma bonds, and ionic bonds do not directly account for the increased stability of chelate complexes.
